title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding transforms categorical variables into a form that could be provided to ML algorithms to do a better job in prediction. Each category is converted into a binary vector. How might this affect the model's complexity?

title: Model Complexity and Bias
text: Adding more features to a model can increase its complexity. Consider how this might affect the bias of the model. Does increasing complexity always increase bias?

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: What happens to the bias of a model when you add more features?

hintAnswer: Adding features can decrease bias but increase variance.
title: Understanding Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: How does the bias-variance tradeoff relate to adding features to a model?
choices: Adding features can decrease bias but increase variance.
Adding features can increase both bias and variance.
Adding features can decrease both bias and variance.
